name: To the Max
source:
'To the Max' details true stories of a Massachusetts video arcade during the Post-Golden Age of Video Games. This visual novel highlights people relations and specific tales of being an arcade employee.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605890/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《To the Max》讲述了电子游戏黄金时代之后，一家马萨诸塞州街机厅里的真实故事。这部视觉小说着重描绘人与人之间的关系，以及担任街机厅员工时的种种经历。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605890/]Steam[/url]]
